summary: The pending → done → failed of one action, in place — "Saving…", "Saved", "Not saved" beside the switch that was flipped or the button that was pressed. A live region that is always mounted, around StatusIndicator's arc, check and octagon.
useWhen: one control saves as soon as it is used — a switch, a row's inline edit — and the user needs to see that it worked
a button's action takes a moment and its result belongs beside it, not in a toast across the screen

useInstead.when: the whole region is loading — a table, a card, a page
useInstead.why: it holds the layout of what is coming; InlineLoading is the state of one action

useInstead.when: the wait has no outcome to report — a panel opening, a search running
useInstead.why: InlineLoading's point is the "Saved" or "Not saved" that follows

useInstead.when: the result is about something off screen, or the user has moved on — a report finished, an export ready
useInstead.why: InlineLoading speaks from where the action was taken

useInstead.when: the status of each row, as data
useInstead.why: it is not a live region; fifty rows of InlineLoading would announce fifty times

composition.note: Mount it with the control and change `status` — never mount it when the save starts. Set `finished` on success and go back to `inactive` in `onSuccess`; leave `error` until the next attempt, with the detail in an Alert. Keep the control enabled while `active` and ignore presses.

inactive.use: nothing to say — an empty live region, waiting

active.use: the default — under way: a spinning arc and "Saving…"

finished.use: it worked: a check and "Saved", until `onSuccess`

error.use: it failed: an octagon and "Not saved", until the next attempt

sm.use: the default — beside a small control or in a row; 16px

requires: keep it mounted: the live region must exist before its words change
`activeLabel`, `finishedLabel` and `errorLabel` — translated, and specific when "Saving…" is not what happens
guarantees: `role="status"` is rendered in every state, so each change of words is announced, politely
each state has its own shape and word, so the outcome is not carried by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1)
the shape is hidden from assistive tech; only the word is announced
finished calls `onSuccess` after `successDelay`, and a re-render does not restart the delay
an error stays until the status changes
notes: the region names nothing — it says what happened to the thing the user just pressed, so put it beside that thing
the in-progress arc stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`; its shape alone says under way

antiPatterns.why: a live region inserted with its words already in it is usually not announced at all
disabling the switch a keyboard user just pressed moves their focus to the top of the page

antiPatterns.dont: a green check and nothing else when it saves
antiPatterns.why: a check alone is silent to a screen reader and only a colour to some sighted users
